# Creator credit 1.0.0

Owner mandate, 2026-09-18: every authored site, proof, prototype, lead demo and applicable web output preserves existing footer/credit text and adds one final centered row linking the exact approved FAMtastic Designs PNG to https://famtasticdesigns.com/. No tier exemption, redraw, recolor, alternate builder-brand inference or runtime dependency. Compact obsidian backing is confined to the link; responsive 160–220px image, minimum 44px link and accessible name are required.

The package bundles the original 2172 × 724 PNG, SHA-256 `ebb0477344132d32e449ba19e2b622921585aa71af0decdbcf8abfbe033fa950`. Source supplied by Fritz: `fd-admin-error-brand-proof/frontend/public/brand/famtastic-designs-logo-v1.png`. Rights are limited to FAMtastic creator attribution; the library's generic license does not authorize logo modification or unrelated use.

Use `appendCreatorCredit` only on newly authored output, then bundle `creatorLogoAsset`. It preserves footer text and is idempotent for semantically compliant final rows, with no marker/version requirement. Header/navigation logos do not suppress footer credit. `requireCreatorCreditFiles` validates the destination (bare or exact safe attribution triplet), accessible link/image, final row and the exact hash of the referenced bundled PNG at its actual path. It recognizes MBSH `v1`, customer `data-fd-creator-credit`, agency markup and unmarked rows without canonicalizing approved bytes. Optional `public_base_path` must explicitly describe a mounted artifact such as `/lab/the-reckoning/`; paths are never guessed from filenames. Scripts/comments/inert templates do not count. Missing/invalid credit produces an actionable new-authored-version error. This is source validation, not browser geometry proof: external CSS centering, responsive 160–220px width, actual 44px target, fixed-overlay clearance, contrast and logo effects still require browser checks. Do not claim rendered compliance solely from these structural checks.

Never rewrite an immutable approved bundle or its historical approval hashes. The global owner mandate authorizes a narrow derived artifact that appends missing creator credit and bundles the exact PNG without regenerating pages or requesting another Fritz/customer approval. Record original/derived file hashes, transformation version and owner mandate in a new internal receipt; preserve the original bundle and approval references. This does not mark the derivative customer-accepted or change payment, authentication, customer state or publication authority. Already compliant artifacts pass byte-identically; invalid existing rows/assets need explicit repair rather than silent replacement. Standalone callers must validate public allowlists, paths and symlinks before reading files; the foundation module itself does not walk directories or mutate source. Site Studio Next owns the receipt-producing transformation.

The default link has no attribution tags. Optional attribution may use only public non-PII `utm_source=<site-or-artifact-slug>&utm_medium=creator_credit&utm_campaign=created_by_famtastic`; this implementation intentionally does not accept arbitrary query strings. Add no cookies or scripts. An exception requires an explicit Fritz Medine instruction recorded with `approved_by`, exact `scope`, `approval_ref` and `reason`; tier, cost, customer preference or model output is not authorization. The record is audit evidence, not cryptographic verification of owner identity.

For nonclickable media, use the exact logo in a reserved credit area where supported; never imply that video/image pixels carry hyperlinks, and never cover QR codes, legal text or customer content. Put links in supported web wrappers/descriptions. Preserve financial, authentication and customer state.
